Field Procedures are step-by-step instructions for completing specific tasks in ''Elite Dangerous''.

Articles in this category focus primarily on '''what to do and in what order''', with a defined objective and a recognizable completion point. Depending on the task, they may also include prerequisites, preparation, expected results, common mistakes, and troubleshooting.

Reference articles should not be placed in this category solely because they contain instructional sections. When a reference article contains a substantial procedure, the procedure may instead be documented separately and linked from the reference article.

For the curated procedure index, see [[Field Procedures]].
